execution_revision.implementation: Self-contained candidate recorder, frozen raw-event schema, calibration, evaluator, timing audit and bounded lifecycle/export wrapper; durable prelaunch ownership checkpoint for outer hard-kill recovery; refuse incomplete startup/warmup calibration and independently audit malformed server chunks without consuming rejected text; preserve server-error envelopes and bounded JSON nesting/integer parser failures as trustworthy failed requests across recorder/evaluator/independent audit

workload.digest_scope: Exact committed canonical LF bytes; the raw run plan digest must match its actual file bytes
workload.calibration_policy: Separate complete baseline capture; freeze a new hash-bound plan before fresh scored captures; observed envelope with no extrapolation

planning_unmeasured.qualification: Arithmetic only. Calibration, quick and full are separate experiments; their combined allocation consumes the controller cash/deletion envelope. Actual full-suite timing includes setup, capture, analysis, export and cleanup.

validation.qualification: Candidate CPU software validation and independent JSON/hash/provenance checks; no official schema acceptance or grading result

measurement.required_next: Retain real baseline calibration and independent evidence verification, freeze measured time/noise/sample-count policy, then collect fresh controls and justified full scoring data.

ownership_checkpoint.publication: Exclusive file creation, file fsync and directory fsync before launch; export allowlisted

ownership_checkpoint.scope: Candidate CPU-tested recovery authority publication; no GPU capture or cloud allocation deletion is claimed
